at_4000.priority: GLM-pair probability mass + 0.35 * min(Fable probability, GLM-pair mass), stable descending.
at_4000.min50: At N<=333 the 15% row cap is below 50; no passes. At N>=334 the 90k estimate permits at least the first 50 even if all long; if resources and previous stages succeed both passes start. No skip based on elapsed time.

actual_time_handling.on_nonzero_exit: Raises from v1_stage; outer check=True aborts before the normal success path; no fallback to one pass.
actual_time_handling.initialization_retry: Early failures before context can halve sequence batch from 8 down to 1; a retry does not bound wall time.
actual_time_handling.finalization_condition: Whatever external hard limit applies must have time left after upstream work for tokenizer setup, both physical passes, CPU head/style and parquet. V8 does not calculate this condition.

team_V4_371529552.models: Same segmented scorers, different row ranking and head; additional ATLAS after GLM

team_dual_glm_371497531.scope: GLM-only diagnostic, includes setup and both heads; no upstream ensemble.

jose_368344742.caution: GLM53 here used a different GPU packing mode from V8. Excluded from the interpolation.

illustrative_only.method: Interpolate in actual token positions between observed 6,581 (team V4 54) and 430,469 (Jose 2,699). V3 cut at 320; V8 cuts at 160. Per-pass estimates exclude upstream ensemble, tokenizer setup and finalization. No knowledge of hidden text lengths; these are neither bounds nor confidence intervals.
illustrative_only.row_sensitivity_scope: Simple count scaling of the entire standalone 270 diagnostic. Counts fixed overhead again per row, ignores text lengths and throughput changes; do not add this scenario to the per-model interpolation.
illustrative_only.scope: No actual full-4,000 V8 run in these receipts. I/O and chunking, upstream model activations, lengths and outside hard limit may change the outcome.
illustrative_only.decision: The confirmed 3-row V8 preview supports trying V8 but cannot validate either full GLM pass. V7 or V1 inheriting the same static two-pass stage does not supply a runtime safeguard. Observe formal elapsed time and status before deciding whether a variant with an explicit deadline is worth a new slot.

conditional_clock_example.interpretation: Conditional arithmetic only, not the current competition rule or a safety margin. Even under these assumptions, for a nine-hour limit, beginning the first physical pass after approximately 7h49m cannot fit the modeled work; setup and finalization need additional headroom. An earlier start does not guarantee completion.
